children: Orkla has today sold an amount of NOK 300 million in ORK89. After this, Orkla holds NOK 200 million on its own account. The outstanding amount in the market after this is NOK 1,300 million.
SEB acted as broker in the transaction.

This information is subject to disclosure under the Norwegian Securities Trading Act, §5-12. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-09-09 20:25 CEST.
